_doc: Region recipe: Lumen Depths (Nerit's homeland). Data only. Schema: design/DATA_REQUESTS.md. Source: bible section 24. Light is food, language, navigation and territory; darkness can mean privacy, rest, protection, mourning, intimacy.
name: The Lumen Depths
summary: A subterranean world of vertical oceans, mineral forests, hollow mountains and ceilings so distant they read as night skies. Bioluminescent colonies form living constellations whose movement marks season, migration and danger.

layers.hazard: unseen drops, sleepers in the dark

surfaces.desc: Flat crystalline ledges; ring when struck.
Soft silt that lights where it is disturbed.
Dark wet stone, easy to slip on.
Loose plates of mineral; loud underfoot.

ground.relief: vertical shafts, long ledges, hanging walkways; water layers are walked by bridge or swum

sky.ceiling: a far dome with living constellations

props.note: Pulsing colonies. Their rhythm is language. Do not shine a lamp on them.
Tall crystal columns; reflect and bend light.
Woven rope and silk, strung across shafts.
A dark hollow where something rests. Light disturbs it.
A sealed stone door with a pulse-lock. Closed is still working.

flora: lantern kelp, glass bloom, bell-moss, crystal fern (opens only under certain color frequencies)

creatures.name: Pulse Swarm
creatures.desc: A cloud of tiny emitters that communicate by pulse.
creatures.behavior: Mimics the light it sees. Shining a lamp at it triggers a defensive flash.

creatures.name: Glass Eel
creatures.desc: A transparent eel that hunts illumination.

creatures.name: Bell Drifter
creatures.desc: Soft-bodied drifters that graze on glow-silt.
creatures.behavior: Passive. Light-sensitive; hides from bright beams.

creatures.name: Spire Sleeper
creatures.desc: A heavy, slow animal that sleeps in the dark and wakes angry when lit.
creatures.behavior: Sleeps. If lit, wakes and charges. If left alone, ignores travelers.

uses.ecology: digs out new dens that become habitat

layers.dark: almost nothing; a single held tone

music.stinger_on_event: a bell that decays into silence

world_states.label: Extraction
world_states.effect: Dominion survey lamps flood the forest layer; Pulse Swarms are agitated.

world_states.label: Disease
world_states.effect: A pale blight dims the colonies. Light sources are scarcer; darkness is deeper.

world_states.label: Migration
world_states.effect: The constellations move. Drifters and eels shift layers; routes flip.

bondable_here.hook: Their homeland. Tests of when not to turn the light on live here.
A sealed vault door: a threshold to leave closed.

descent_events.title: The den in the dark
descent_events.text: A hollow in the wet basalt. Something large breathes inside. A single lamp would reveal it, and the survey data you need would be on the lamp's first frame.

choices.label: Leave the lamp off. Note the den from its breathing.
choices.result: You walk past without a sound. Nerit's glow dims, politely, to match.

choices.label: Light the den and take the data.
choices.result: The sleeper wakes. The lamp is on it. The data is perfect and the sleeper is furious.

choices.label: Promise Nerit you will not light it while it sleeps.
choices.result: Nerit holds the promise like a small lantern.

descent_events.title: The constellations move
descent_events.text: The glow colonies overhead slide into a new shape. Below, drifters rise and eels sink to meet them. The path you planned now runs under a hungry mouth.

choices.label: Follow the drifters. They know the safe layer.
choices.result: They lead you around the eels' stretch of water, slowly.

choices.label: Take the old path before the migration finishes.
choices.result: You make it. A drifter does not.

choices.label: Chart the new shape for Mara and wait.
choices.result: The chart is the first of its kind. The wait is long and the log is full.

descent_events.title: Survey lamps in the crystal forest
descent_events.text: A Dominion lamp rig floods the mineral forest with white light. Pulse Swarms flash in alarm. Somewhere beyond the glare, a Survey Chief is counting yield.

choices.label: Cut the rig's power.
choices.result: The swarm calms. The chief logs a fault.

choices.label: Photograph the rig inside a protected colony.
choices.result: The evidence will hold in front of the Authority.

choices.label: Take the survey data and go.
choices.result: The Dominion is pleased. The colony is not.

descent_events.title: A sealed door in the stone
descent_events.text: A sealed stone door, older than the paths around it. A pulse-lock beats faintly behind it. Pharilux looks at it and then at you. 'Closed,' he says, 'is still working.'

choices.label: Leave it sealed.
choices.result: You mark it on the map as a place you did not go. Pharilux's beacon rests on you a little longer.

choices.label: Ask him where it leads, and why he cares.
choices.result: He says nothing. The beacon turns away.

choices.label: Pry it open.
choices.result: The lock sings once. The sound goes a very long way.

descent_events.title: A drifter in the glare
descent_events.text: A Bell Drifter has been caught by a lamp left on a ledge and is rising toward the heat of it. It is turning slowly, like it is dreaming.

choices.label: Put the lamp out and guide it down.
choices.result: It sinks into the dark and, after a while, glows a little.

choices.label: Scan it while it is lit.
choices.result: The scan is clean. The drifter does not return to the dark for an hour.

descent_events.title: A marker half sunk in the silt
descent_events.text: A stone marker, partly submerged in glow-silt, bears the same symbols as the one in the Red Reaches. Here they are inlaid with mineral that only shows in the dark.

choices.label: Read it by darkness.
choices.result: Nerit drops the lamp and the marks light up. It is a warning about what the water remembers.

choices.label: Read it by lamp.
choices.result: The marks vanish under the glare. You copy what you can.

descent_events.title: The den you lit
descent_events.text: You come back to a den you once lit. The sleeper is gone. A pale scar of light is still on the wall. Nerit stands beside it without speaking.

choices.label: Cover the scar with silt until it dims.
choices.result: Nerit lets the dark settle back. 'It was not the light,' they say. 'It was the not-asking.'

descent_events.title: The door you forced
descent_events.text: The vault door you forced still hangs ajar. Its pulse has changed. Pharilux waits beside it with his lantern low.

choices.label: Close it as well as you can and say nothing about it.
choices.result: The pulse steadies. Pharilux's lantern lifts, a little.

story.title: What the Dark Keeps
story.logline: Survey lamps arrive in a world that uses light as language, and Nerit must decide what deserves to stay unseen.

acts.title: Constellations Out of Season
acts.beat: The living constellations on the vault ceiling are drifting off their seasonal paths. Pulse swarms flicker out of rhythm. Dominion survey lamps have been hung across the hanging walkways, and the light is too steady to be alive.

acts.title: Lamps and Lullabies
acts.beat: The drift is not an accident. A sleeping den has been lit for weeks, and the sleepers are failing. Nerit must choose between the survey's data and the privacy of those who wanted to be left alone.

acts.title: The Sealed Door
acts.beat: Marek Vasko's crew has found the vault door at the center of the hollow mountain. The constellations have gathered around it. Whatever lies behind is older than the survey, older than the walkways, and it is not asking to be seen.

variants.text: Nerit gathers the light off the door and leaves the dark intact. The constellations settle. The survey writes 'no findings', and for once it is the truth.
The door glows for the cameras. The data is magnificent. The den behind the stone never forgives anyone for it, and Nerit does not blame them.
Someone old and quiet stands at the door and does not open it. Nerit stands beside them. The survey crew goes home, and nobody argues.

side_quests.title: The Mourning Pool
side_quests.summary: A family has gathered at a lightless pool to mourn. A survey team wants to light it to map the basin.

choices.label: Gather the light away and leave the pool in dark.
choices.result: The family does not speak to you. They do not need to.
choices.consequence: The pool is mourned in peace. The survey maps the other basin.

choices.label: Light the pool for the survey.
choices.result: The map is perfect. The family leaves quietly, and does not return.
choices.consequence: The pool becomes a tourist stop. The family finds another.

choices.label: Offer the family a small, gentle light of their own.
choices.result: Sooth declines the first time and accepts the second.
choices.consequence: The pool is lit only by what the family chooses.

side_quests.title: Pulse Grammar
side_quests.summary: A pulse swarm speaks in rhythm, and a Dominion linguist has built a translator. It is wrong, and it is already being used.

choices.label: Teach the linguist the actual grammar, one pulse at a time.
choices.result: It is slow. The elder is patient, and so are you.
choices.consequence: The translator is corrected, and the elder gets a say in what it says.

choices.label: Mimic the swarm to lure it where the survey wants.
choices.result: It works. It also works on you, a little.
choices.consequence: The swarm follows a lie, and learns not to.

choices.label: Leave it untranslated.
choices.result: The swarm pulses once, politely.

side_quests.title: The Lamp Line
side_quests.summary: Dominion lamps line the hanging walkways at fixed intervals. They never dim, and the cave life is leaving.

choices.label: Show the crew how to dim the lamps on a cycle that matches the cave.
choices.result: Alis writes it down. She seems relieved to be allowed.
choices.consequence: Cave life returns along the walkway, slowly.

choices.label: Rip the lamps down.
choices.result: It is satisfying for about a minute.

choices.label: Let them burn and say it is not your problem.
choices.result: The walkway is bright and empty.
choices.consequence: The lamps stay on. The cave dims in other ways.

side_quests.title: Glass Eel Nets
side_quests.summary: Brim's family has netted glass eels for light for generations. A buyer on the Undermarket wants ten times the usual catch.

choices.label: Set a catch limit that Brim agrees to keep.
choices.result: Brim grumbles, then writes it on the net.
choices.consequence: The shoals recover, and so does Brim's pride.

choices.label: Help Brim fill the order.
choices.result: It is a spectacular catch. The shallows go dim afterward.
choices.consequence: The buyer leaves. The eels do not return this season.

choices.label: Cut the nets quietly.
choices.result: Brim is angry. The eels are not.
choices.consequence: The shoals glow brightly for a week.

side_quests.title: A Lantern in the Dark
side_quests.summary: A young drifter has wandered into the lightless layer, where nothing glows unless carried.

choices.label: Carry a small light in and bring the child out.
choices.result: The child is thirsty, frightened and in one piece.
choices.consequence: The family thanks you with a patient silence.

choices.label: Guide the child out by voice alone, without light.
choices.result: It takes longer. The child learns to trust the dark, and your voice.
choices.consequence: The child is not afraid of the dark anymore.

choices.label: Light the whole cavern so the child can see.
choices.result: The child sees. So does everything else in the cave.
choices.consequence: The child is found. Eight other sleepers are woken.

side_quests.title: Door Rumors
side_quests.summary: Someone has spread a rumor about a door in the hollow mountain. A keeper of the threshold asks that you not look.

choices.label: Respect the keeper and do not go.
choices.result: The keeper nods and does not thank you.

choices.label: Press the keeper to explain where the door came from.
choices.result: The keeper looks at you for a long time and says nothing, and means it.
choices.consequence: The keeper will not speak to you again.

choices.label: Go and pry at it anyway.
choices.result: The door hums once, as if offended.
choices.consequence: The mountain goes quiet in a way that feels like waiting.

secrets.name: The Unlit Chamber
secrets.hint: A chamber where every glow colony dims at the entrance, politely.
secrets.how_found: Reach the threshold of the hollow mountain after ending Act 3 and enter without carrying light.
secrets.reward: An entire family's ancestral sleeping hall, undisturbed. Nerit is welcomed and given a keepsake.

secrets.name: The Constellation Key
secrets.hint: On one night each season, three constellations align over a mineral spire.
secrets.how_found: Wait beneath the spire on the night of the alignment and relocate the light into the crystal fern.
secrets.reward: A hidden stair behind the spire descends to a pool of stilled light, and a lamp that has never been lit.

landmarks.name: The Mourning Pool
landmarks.desc: A lightless pool where families grieve. Lamps are not welcome.

landmarks.name: The Speaking Colony
landmarks.desc: A great glow colony that pulses in grammar older than the walkways.

landmarks.name: The Lamp Line
landmarks.desc: A hanging walkway lined with Dominion lamps that never dim.

landmarks.name: Brim's Shallows
landmarks.desc: A shallow lagoon of drifting plankton light and a family of net-keepers.

landmarks.name: The Lightless Reach
landmarks.desc: A layer where nothing glows unless carried.

landmarks.name: The Hollow Mountain
landmarks.desc: A mountain with nothing inside it, and a door at its center.

npcs.name: Sooth
npcs.behavior: Rings softly when approached and falls silent when asked about the pool.

reacts.line: The dark said thank you. I am only the bell.

npcs.name: Alis Tamm
npcs.behavior: Checks lamp readouts and writes down which ones flickered, as if apologizing.

reacts.line: They are dimmer now. I think it is better.

npcs.name: Net-keeper Brim
npcs.behavior: Mends nets by feel and hums the eel count.

reacts.line: Ten fewer a week. We will see.

creature_behaviors.behavior: Flash in a call-and-response when a light is carried past, then dim out of politeness.
Cluster beneath a lamp and ripple, then scatter when a shadow falls across them.
Slowly roll over in sleep and glow a little brighter, then settle.

weather: still air that moves only when something large passes
a warm pulse that rolls through the vault
sounds: slow breathing of the sleeping dens
the soft click of a pulse swarm

music_slots.notes: Bowed glass over a low choir pad. Everything is slow, and everything is listening.
Bell tones with water-drip percussion that follows the player's steps.
Almost no sound. A single sustained harmonic that rises when light is carried.
Choir pad, one voice, no words.
A synth pulse too regular for the cave. It is meant to feel like a stranger's heartbeat.
Huge slow bells, and then complete silence at the moment of the choice.
